page.overview:
What is Settled Worlds?

The Settled Worlds was the name given to the colonized planets of the Tython system during the Pre-Republic era, after a number of sentients were brought to the system by the Tho Yor ships. The Settled Worlds were established during the second migration.

Shikaakwa served as the nexus between the Outer and Inner Settled Worlds.
